name: Sentry
summary: Read the error and reliability signals you choose for a recipe.

setup.credential_label: Sentry connection approved in your own Hermes setup
setup.recommended_scope: Read-only access to the Sentry projects and issues you choose to summarize.
setup.customer_action: In your own setup, connect Sentry with read-only access and choose the projects this recipe may read.

customer_setup.summary: Choose the Sentry projects whose reliability signals you want in the recipe.
steps: Pick the Sentry projects and issue signals that matter.
Approve read-only access inside your own Hermes setup.
Review one test summary before enabling a schedule.
customer_setup.secret_handling: Agent Recipes never asks for, displays, stores, or logs connection secrets. Complete authorization only in your customer-owned runtime.

verification.success_looks_like: A test brief reports only the selected Sentry signals and cannot resolve, mute, or edit any issue.
steps: Confirm the selected Sentry projects appear in the plan.
Confirm no Sentry issue was changed.

rollback.scope: Only the Sentry connection for this selected recipe.
steps: Pause this recipe before changing its connection.
Remove only this recipe's Sentry connection in your own runtime.
Leave unrelated recipes and Sentry connections unchanged.
